item.title: The Life of a Show Mom: An INSIDE LOOK at the Livestock Shows at the Florida State Fair
item.description: With the Florida State Fair kicking off on Feb. 5, my daughter is ready for her Super Bowl. The Florida State Fair is a culminating show for thousands of livestock exhibitors all over the state of Florida. Youth will come and show off all of their hard work in the TECO Arena with their animals and knowledge of all species.
